knowledge:
- key_parameters: esetList=An ExpressionSetList object containing the ExpressionSet objects for each study, which must share identical featureNames ;; phenotypeLabel=A character string indicating the binary clinical covariate in the phenoData of each ExpressionSet ;; one.delta=Logical; if TRUE, fits the delta_g model (gene is differentially expressed in all studies or none), if FALSE, fits the delta_gp model (gene can be differentially expressed in a subset of studies) ;; burnin=Logical; if TRUE, MCMC chains are not written to file and only the last iteration is saved ;; iterations=Integer; the number of MCMC iterations to run ;; thin=Integer; interval for writing MCMC iterations to file (e.g., 2 writes every other iteration) ;; directory=Character; path where MCMC log files are written ;; output=Named vector indicating which parameters to save to log files (0 = not saved, 1 = saved)
- alternatives: GeneMeta=Meta-analysis using z-scores ;; metaArray=Latent variable approach for meta-analysis ;; rankProduct=Rank-based non-parametric method ;; MergeMaid=For unsupervised gene filtering and integrative correlation if cross-study correlation is low
- when_to_use: Appropriate when combining two or more transcriptomic studies addressing similar biological questions with a shared binary clinical covariate, especially when individual studies have small sample sizes and technological differences need to be filtered out.
- pitfalls: Providing a replacement vector of incorrect length to firstMcmc can cause the MCMC algorithm to crash without warning ;; Saving chains for parameters indexed by genes and/or studies (e.g., nu, DDelta, delta, probDelta, sigma2, phi) requires a very large amount of memory and disk space; they should be turned off (set to 0 in output) if not strictly needed ;; Low cross-study correlation (low reproducibility) can cause wrong borrowing of strength in the Bayesian model, shrinking concordant differential expression to noise. Unsupervised filtering (e.g., integrative correlation) is recommended beforehand in such cases.

workflows.name: bayesian_cross_study_analysis
workflows.intent: Fit a Bayesian hierarchical model to multiple transcriptomic studies to estimate concordant and discordant differential expression.
input: Multiple ExpressionSet objects (with identical featureNames and a shared binary phenotype covariate) combined into an ExpressionSetList.
workflows.stages:
1. Create and validate the ExpressionSetList.
2. Initialize the XdeParameter object with the phenotype label.
3. (Optional) Generate empirical starting values using empiricalStart.
4. Configure MCMC parameters (iterations, burn-in, thinning, output logs, directory).
5. Run the MCMC chain using xde.
6. Read saved chains and assess convergence.
7. Calculate posterior averages and Bayesian effect sizes using calculatePosteriorAvg and calculateBayesianEffectSize.
8. Identify interesting genes using symbolsInteresting and visualize.
workflows.code:
library(XDE)
data(expressionSetList)
xlist <- expressionSetList
class(xlist)
validObject(xlist)
stopifnot(all(sapply(xlist, function(x, label){ label %in% varLabels(x)}, label="adenoVsquamous")))
params <- new("XdeParameter", esetList=xlist, phenotypeLabel="adenoVsquamous")
params
params <- new("XdeParameter", esetList=xlist, phenotypeLabel="adenoVsquamous", one.delta=FALSE)
empirical <- empiricalStart(xlist, phenotypeLabel="adenoVsquamous")
firstMcmc(params) <- empirical
iterations(params) <- 3
burnin(params) <- TRUE
fit <- xde(params, xlist)
iterations(params) <- 2
fit2 <- xde(params, xlist, fit)
firstMcmc(params) <- lastMcmc(fit)
seed(params) <- seed(fit)
fit2 <- xde(params, xlist)
burnin(params) <- FALSE
iterations(params) <- 2000
output(params)[c("potential", "acceptance",
		 "diffExpressed",
		 "nu",
		 "probDelta",
		 "phi")] <- 0
thin(params) <- 2
directory(params) <- "logFiles"
xmcmc <- xde(params, xlist)
postAvg <- calculatePosteriorAvg(xmcmc, NCONC=2, NDIFF=1)
bayesianEffectSize(xmcmc) <- calculateBayesianEffectSize(xmcmc)
pathToLogFiles <- system.file("logFiles", package="XDE")
xmcmc@directory <- pathToLogFiles
c2 <- xmcmc$c2
par(las=1)
plot.ts(c2, ylab="c2", xlab="iterations", plot.type="single")
load(file.path(pathToLogFiles, "BES.rda"))
load(file.path(pathToLogFiles, "postAvg.rda"))
op.conc <- symbolsInteresting(rankingStatistic=postAvg[, "concordant"])
op.disc <- symbolsInteresting(rankingStatistic=postAvg[, "discordant"])
par(las=1)
graphics:::pairs(BES[op.conc$order, ], pch=op.conc$pch, col=op.conc$col,
                 bg=op.conc$bg, upper.panel=NULL, cex=op.conc$cex)
graphics:::pairs(BES[op.disc$order, ], pch=op.disc$pch, col=op.disc$col, bg=op.disc$bg,
		 upper.panel=NULL, cex=op.disc$cex)
